GrowThroughoutLife.title: Growing Through Reflection and Openness
GrowThroughoutLife.text:
I can recognise that learning and growth happen through reflection, challenge, and openness to different people and experiences.

At this stage, pupils begin to understand that personal growth happens not just through success, but through reflection and challenge. They explore how experiences help them grow and recognise learning as lifelong.

ExplorePossibilities.title: Discovering Interests and Careers
ExplorePossibilities.text:
I can explore different jobs by thinking about what interests me, the skills they require, and how my school choices connect to future opportunities.

Pupils begin linking interests and subjects to possible careers and exploring the world of work.

ManagingCareer.title: Understanding What a Career Means
ManagingCareer.text:
I can explore different career options and begin setting simple goals.

Pupils explore what a career means and recognise it is built over time.

CreateOpportunities.title: Exploring Careers and Learning from Others
CreateOpportunities.text:
I can understand how opportunities are created through relationships and teamwork.

Pupils learn that careers are built through collaboration and role models.

BalanceWorkLife.title: Understanding Balance and Well-Being
BalanceWorkLife.text:
I can understand how work and life are connected and how balance affects well-being and opportunities.

Pupils explore how balance influences happiness and success.

SeeTheBigPicture.title: Understanding the World of Work
SeeTheBigPicture.text:
I can begin to recognise how trends, technology, and the environment influence work.

Pupils develop awareness of wider influences on careers.

GrowThroughoutLife.title: Embracing Feedback and Self-Awareness
GrowThroughoutLife.text:
I can recognise how learning, feedback, and self-awareness help me grow.

Pupils reflect on strengths and areas for growth, building resilience and identity awareness.

ExplorePossibilities.title: Broadening Horizons and Understanding Pathways
ExplorePossibilities.text:
I can explore a wide range of jobs, learning pathways, and qualifications.

Pupils investigate recruitment and broader pathways.

ManagingCareer.title: Planning Ahead and Being Flexible
ManagingCareer.text:
I can build relationships and recognise creativity and leadership in building a career.

Pupils develop planning skills and adaptability.

CreateOpportunities.title: Building Initiative and Leadership Skills
CreateOpportunities.text:
I can take initiative and develop leadership and entrepreneurial thinking.

Pupils develop proactive attitudes and confidence.

BalanceWorkLife.title: Recognising Responsibilities and Managing Balance
BalanceWorkLife.text:
I can recognise the importance of work-life balance and managing responsibilities.

Pupils build healthy habits and self-awareness.

SeeTheBigPicture.title: Exploring How the World Shapes Careers
SeeTheBigPicture.text:
I can understand how technology, society, and the economy influence careers.

Pupils think strategically about external influences.

GrowThroughoutLife.title: Taking Responsibility for Growth
GrowThroughoutLife.text:
I can take responsibility for my growth by embracing feedback and setting learning goals.

Pupils take ownership of long-term development.

ExplorePossibilities.title: Researching Careers and Preparing for Success
ExplorePossibilities.text:
I can research career options and understand recruitment processes.

Pupils prepare for applications and interviews.

ManagingCareer.title: Making Decisions and Managing Change
ManagingCareer.text:
I can take responsibility for my career and adapt my strategies.

Pupils develop confident self-advocacy.

CreateOpportunities.title: Taking Ownership and Leading with Confidence
CreateOpportunities.text:
I can reflect on my progress and advocate for my goals.

Pupils strengthen independence and leadership capacity.

BalanceWorkLife.title: Reflecting on Life, Work, and Financial Realities
BalanceWorkLife.text:
I can reflect on balancing work, life, well-being, finances, and responsibilities.

Pupils consider adult responsibilities and lifestyle decisions.

SeeTheBigPicture.title: Evaluating Trends and Making Informed Decisions
SeeTheBigPicture.text:
I can critically evaluate how trends shape career opportunities.

Pupils develop critical thinking and informed decision-making.
